text:
maria-g: Heads-up — spike: a customer wants per-tenant regional bias with soft failover and per-region quota enforcement. Can we sketch a minimal policy that fits current route matcher?

kai: Do we mean bias as in weights (prefer us-west:70, eu-west:30) but still fail to eu if us is degraded?

maria-g: Exactly. Preference, not hard affinity. Also need to record every fallback event for billing & alerts.

anika: Two quick constraints: (1) we already have header-based overrides (X-Redwood-Region) that bypass geo logic for internal customers, (2) route matcher order is currently longest-prefix then header checks.

pradeep: If header overrides are higher priority, tenants can't express soft bias via headers harmlessly. Maybe introduce a `region_preference` field in the route config instead of relying on headers.

kai: +1 for explicit config. Proposal: policy object: `{ "preference": [{"region":"us-west","weight":70},{"region":"eu-west","weight":30}], "failover": ["eu-west","us-east"], "quota_scope":"region|global", "telemetry_sample":0.1 }`

anika: That looks fine. Two implementation notes: (A) routing decision must remain deterministic for a request id so tracing matches telemetry, (B) we must avoid adding per-request RNG in hot path.

maria-g: For determinism maybe hash(request_id) mod 100 compared to cumulative weights. Will that play nicely with retries/hedging?

pradeep: Good point. Retries should prefer same region to avoid head-of-line mismatch unless region failed. For hedging we can use first attempt region from hash, hedges go to top-2 weighted regions.

kai: On telemetry: sample every fallback (when chosen_region != preferred_region) at 100% for that request, but global sampling of normal successes at 1% to save ingestion costs. We need a telemetry flag in the decision response so proxies add a `X-RW-Routed-Region` header and `X-RW-Telemetry=full|sample`.

maria-g: Agreed. We also need to emit a metric tag `fallback=true` and the reason (`latency_spike, quota_exhaust, capacity`), plus tenant id.

anika: About quotas: if tenant has per-region quotas, policy should check quotas before routing. If preferred region quota exhausted, treat as a failure reason and pick next region by weight. That means quota check must be a cheap synchronous call or cached token bucket in edge.

pradeep: Caching token buckets per-tenant per-region is doable but memory heavy. Maybe a leaky-bucket sketch with per-tenant warm entries + eviction. Fallback reason stays `quota_exhaust` in telemetry.

kai: UX for console: expose a simple slider to indicate bias (0 = strict local, 100 = prefer-local-for-everything) and toggle for `respect_quotas` and `record_full_telemetry`. Advanced JSON view for exact weights.

maria-g: Rollout plan: feature gate for tenants flagged with `regional_bias_v2`. Start with internal tenants + 5 customers. Canary on one edge zone, then ramp. Need a console banner explaining that failover is soft and may increase cross-region egress.

anika: One more internal API debate: Should the policy be evaluated in the control plane and pushed as routing buckets, or computed live at the edge? Control-plane gives consistency but slower updates. Live computation allows instant tenant-level overrides.

pradeep: Hybrid: compile policy to a small routing table with weights and quota hints in control plane, push to edge; edge makes final decision with local hashing + quota state. That keeps fast path cheap.

kai: Pseudocode for the edge decision:\n\n```\npreferred = pick_by_hash(weights, request_id)\nif quota_exhaust(preferred):\n  emit_telemetry(reason=\"quota_exhaust\", fallback=true)\n  chosen = pick_next_weighted(preferred)\nelif region_unhealthy(preferred):\n  emit_telemetry(reason=\"latency_spike\", fallback=true)\n  chosen = pick_next_weighted(preferred)\nelse:\n  chosen = preferred\nset_header(\"X-RW-Routed-Region\", chosen)\n```

pradeep: That covers it. One operational ask: add a histogram metric for `routing.decisions.by_tenant` and a counter `routing.fallbacks.{reason}`. Also tag events with `policy_version` for rollout analytics.

maria-g: OK team — action items: (1) @kai draft control-plane schema and edge pseudocode PR, (2) @anika design telemetry sampling knobs + header names, (3) @pradeep estimate memory for token-bucket cache and fallback metric cardinality. I'll draft the console UX mock and rollout checklist.

srebot: deploy-bot: created issue RW-1342 in eng-platform backlog for `regional bias v2` with labels: feature, telemetry, rollout

maria-g: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to go over the schema and constraints. :thumbsup:
